claims.claim: In the default run (climate=off), the climate module computes no temperature; pm_gmt_conv, pm_globalMeanTemperature, pm_globalMeanTemperatureZeroed1900 and pm_temperatureImpulseResponseCO2 are set to 0 at off/datainput.gms:53-56 and never updated
16_downscaleTemperature, 45_carbonprice, 50_damages and 51_internalizeDamages therefore all see zero warming, so temperature-dependent damages are inactive or trivial
claims.note: By default, downscaleTemperature, damages and internalizeDamages are all off, and the default carbonprice (NPi2025) does not read temperature. Only specific non-default realizations read these parameters. The answer reads as if these modules are running in a default run.

claims.claim: The off realization still loads exogenous non-CO2 forcing from the file chosen by cm_rcp_scen (default rcp45 -> data_oghgf_rcp45.inc), and loads pm_emicapglob depending on cm_rcp_scen and cm_multigasscen
In magicc7_ar6, datainput initializes pm_globalMeanTemperature to 1 (line 75)

From iteration 2 on, postsolve unloads fulldata_postsolve, runs climateAssessmentInterimRun.R (~2-3 min, harmonization+infilling+MAGICC), then loads p15_forc_magicc and pm_globalMeanTemperature from p15_climate (lines 33-34); values after 2100 are held at 2100 (line 37)

If cm_magicc_calibrateTemperature2000 is HADCRUT4, temperature is shifted so the 2006-2015 mean is 0.97; this block also computes pm_gmt_conv and stores p15_gmt0. The default is uncalibrated, in which case pm_gmt_conv stays at its initial value
The TIRF is filled only if cm_magicc_temperatureImpulseResponse=on (default off); the script runs for iterations <=10 and every fifth iteration after that, adding ~10 min
With cm_iterative_target_adj=2 and cm_emiscen=9, pm_taxCO2eq is rescaled toward the forcing target between iterations
All 3 configs that select magicc7_ar6 set HADCRUT4, cm_emiscen=10, cm_iterative_target_adj=0 and cm_startyear=2030
claims.note: Correct. However, the answer does not mention that 2 of the 3 configs switch cm_magicc_temperatureImpulseResponse on, so the TIRF branch is actually used in practice.

grade.went_well: The answer leads with the default state (temperature fixed at zero) and gives exact line citations. It accurately walks through magicc7_ar6/postsolve.gms: the iteration gate, the R script, extension past 2100, HADCRUT4 calibration, the 1900 offset, TIRF gating and the tax rescaling. It checks switch defaults (uncalibrated, TIRF off) and the real scenario configs. It also notes the subtle point that pm_gmt_conv is not updated when uncalibrated.
grade.answer_key_issues: There is no contradiction. The answer goes further than the key: the off realization still loads RCP non-CO2 forcing and pm_emicapglob, HADCRUT4 calibration is gated by a switch, and the TIRF is optional. One oddity is worth noting in the key: main.gms:273 says 16_downscaleTemperature/CMIP5 requires climate=off, yet CMIP5/postsolve.gms:12 scales pm_globalMeanTemperature, which off sets to 0. Unless the parameter is loaded elsewhere, that combination produces only the 2005 calibration offset.
grade.summary: The answer is accurate and well cited. Every substantive claim about the off and magicc7_ar6 realizations, the switch defaults and the RIKEN configs checks out against the code. The only flaw is minor: it lists the downscaling and damage modules as consumers of zero temperature in a default run without saying that those modules are themselves off by default.
